rules.accepted_credit_types: Clinical veterinary medicine/technology or patient-safety courses (recordkeeping, OSHA) sponsored by AVMA and its constituent associations/specialty organizations, AVMA-accredited colleges, international/national/regional conferences, academies, state vet-tech associations, NAVTA, community colleges with vet-tech programs, government agencies, AAHA, Board-recognized journals or veterinary information networks, or AAVSB RACE-approved entities
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first renewal after initial licensure by examination.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; documents due within 14 days. Keep original documents 2 years after renewal.
rules.notes: Licensed veterinary technicians: annual renewal by January 1 with 8 h. Up to 1 h may come from unpaid services via a local health department or free clinic (1 h per 3 h).
rules.rule_quote: Veterinarians shall be required to have completed a minimum of 15 hours, and veterinary technicians shall be required to have completed a minimum of eight hours, of approved continuing education for each annual renewal of licensure.
